description: Find people on 1lev1 by a skill or a role (e.g. "video editing", "designer"), to partner with. Returns how many people match, and names (username, skills, roles, public profile page) only of those who chose to be findable by agents - never contact details. To reach everyone who matches, prepare an open mission (prepareMissionTool): once published, the platform suggests it to them in their own mission suggestions. It contacts nobody itself. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#findPartnersTool

query.description: A skill or role, a word or two.

name: findPartnersTool
